newsitem.title: UK: BOE says Clementi will not attend Aug MPC meeting.
newsitem.headline: BOE says Clementi will not attend Aug MPC meeting.

text.p: The new Bank of England deputy governor David Clementi will not attend the August 6 and 7 meeting of the monetary policy committee, a spokesman said on Thursday.
"David Clementi will not be joining the Bank until September and the first monetary policy committee meeting he will attend is on September 10 and 11," he told Reuters.

At next week's meeting the following will attend with voting rights: Bank of England Governor Eddie George, directors Mervyn King and Ian Plenderleith, and two of the outside appointees, Charles Goodhart and Willem Buiter.
In September they will be joined by Clementi and the third outside appointee DeAnne Julius from British Airways who also joins the Bank on September 1.

The spokesman said the Bank hopes Sir Alan Budd, the fourth outside appointee, will join later in the autumn following his retirement as chief economic adviser at the Treasury. He may attend the August and September MPC meetings as the Treasury's non-voting observer.
